summary.text: Ken Upchurch is a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 52, with House service from 1999 to 2010 and again since 2013. The legislature's profile lists Upchurch as chair of the Budget Review Subcommittee on Transportation.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Ken Upchurch is an insurance agent with Upchurch Insurance and Financial Services, Inc.
The profile lists a B.A. in political science from Eastern Kentucky University and a board seat at Immanuel Christian Academy.
